# GNN-RAG in NeSyQA

This directory vendors GNN-RAG for the NeSyQA experiments so the exact code used
for the paper artifact is tracked directly in this repository.

- Upstream repository: `https://github.com/cmavro/GNN-RAG.git`
- Upstream base commit: `28d31bc0db3d54f0930e6125f1c98b5b1ace1ba4`
- Local purpose: NeSyQA integration and experiment support

Generated experiment outputs under `llm/results/` are intentionally ignored.
